__comment: SYNTHETIC FIXTURE — not a recording of any site.
Reproduces the chapter-list API. The whole list comes back in one response
— there is no cursor to walk here, unlike the search endpoint.
**This fixture is deliberately descending**, because that is the order the
real API answers in and because a fixture that were ascending would let a
theme that never sorted anything pass a test about sorting.
TestChaptersAreAscending fails against this file if SortAndMark is removed.
It also carries the case a plain sort-by-number gets wrong: the one-shot
has no chapter number at all and sits between 5 and 4 in the site's order.
Sorting by number would fling it to one end of the list; order.go's rule —
the numbered chapters descend, so reverse the whole list — keeps it where
the site put it, between 4 and 5 ascending.
Deliberate variations exercised by the test:
- volumes are present on some chapters and null on others, which is what
PLAN §6 M4 needs in order to decide whether it has volume structure
- one chapter has a decimal number and a name; one has a number and no
name; one has a name and no number
- one chapter is credited to two groups
- one has an unparseable created_at, which must yield the zero time
rather than an error
Why synthetic: see testdata/search.json. Host is example.invalid (RFC 2606).
